query.text: declare @$pageCount int; select @$pageCount = case when @@pageCount < 0 then 0 else @@pageCount end; exec zFastBusiness$App$Voucher$Loading @@id, @@master, @@prime, @@partition, @@expression, @@extension, @$pageCount, 'stt_rec', @@textList, @@textExternal, 'a left join dmkh b on a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh', @@textOrderBy, @@admin, @@userID, @@viewAccessMode, 0, @@queryString , default , default, default, default, default, default, default, default, 'stt_rec, line_nbr,ma_td1, ma_hd, ma_sp, ma_vv, ma_td3', 'd31$', ' left join d31$ d1 on a.stt_rec = d1.stt_rec and d1.line_nbr = 1 left join dmhd hd on d1.ma_hd = hd.ma_hd left join dmdtqt3 qt3 on d1.ma_td3 = qt3.ma_dtqt left join zvdmvv vv on d1.ma_vv = vv.ma_vv outer apply (select max(ngay_ct0) as ngay_ct0, cast(stuff((select '', '' + ltrim(so_ct0) from (select distinct stt_rec, ltrim(rtrim(so_ct0)) so_ct0 from ctgt30 where exists (select 1 from d31$ x where a.stt_rec = x.stt_rec) ) t30_sub where t30_sub.stt_rec = a.stt_rec for xml path(''''), type).value(''.'', ''nvarchar(max)''), 1, 2, '''') as nvarchar(500)) as so_ct0 from ctgt30 t30_main where t30_main.stt_rec = a.stt_rec) t30'

select top 0 * into #dtmp from d31$000000 set @q = 'insert into #dtmp select * from d31$%Partition where %[line_nbr = 1]%' exec FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @ngay_ct1, @ngay_ct2, 1, 1
select top 0 stt_rec into #m from m31$000000 set @q = 'insert into #m select stt_rec from m31$%Partition' exec FastBusiness$Partition$Execute @q, NULL, 'ngay_ct', @ngay_ct1, @ngay_ct2, 1, 1
select top 0 stt_rec, cast( ' ' as nvarchar(MAX)) as so_ct0, ngay_ct as ngay_ct0 into #ds_hd from m31$000000 set @q = ';with hoa_don as ( select distinct stt_rec, ngay_ct0, so_ct0 from ctgt30 a where exists (select 1 from #m x where a.stt_rec = x.stt_rec) ), ds_hoa_don as( SELECT a.stt_rec, max(ngay_ct0) ngay_ct0, STUFF(( SELECT '', '' + LTRIM(RTRIM(so_ct0)) FROM hoa_don b WHERE stt_rec = a.stt_rec ORDER BY ngay_ct0, so_ct0 FOR XML PATH(''''), TYPE).value(''.'', ''NVARCHAR(MAX)''), 1, 2, '''') AS so_ct0 FROM hoa_don a GROUP BY a.stt_rec ) insert into #ds_hd select stt_rec, so_ct0, ngay_ct0 from ds_hoa_don' exec(@q)
exec FastBusiness$App$Voucher$Finding @@id, @@master, @@prime, @@inquiry, @@partition, @@expression, @@increase, @@extension, @@refresh, @@pageIndex, @@pageCount, @@lastPage, @@lastCount, @@firstItem, @@lastItem, @@keyMaster, @@keyDetail, 'stt_rec', @@textList, @@textExternal, 'a left join dmkh b on a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh left join #dtmp d1 on a.stt_rec = d1.stt_rec left join dmhd hd on d1.ma_hd = hd.ma_hd left join dmdtqt3 qt3 on d1.ma_td3 = qt3.ma_dtqt left join zvdmvv vv on d1.ma_vv = vv.ma_vv left join #ds_hd t30 on a.stt_rec = t30.stt_rec', @@textOrderBy, @@admin, @@userID, @@viewAccessMode, @ngay_ct1, @ngay_ct2, @so_ct1, @so_ct2, @status, @user_id0, @ma_dvcs

declare @q nvarchar(max), @slstt_rec nvarchar(max) select @slstt_rec = text from @lstt_rec
select top 0 @slstt_rec as data, b.line_nbr, b.stt_rec, cast(null as varchar(max)) as ddyn , ma_td1 as d_ma_td1, ma_hd as d_ma_hd, ma_sp as d_ma_sp, ma_vv as d_ma_vv , cast(null as varchar(max)) so_ct0, cast(null as smalldatetime) as ngay_ct0 into #m from d&ddTable;$000000 b right join (select null as v) x on 1 = 0
insert into #m(data) select data from [dbo].[FastBusiness$Function$System$Split](@slstt_rec, char(252)) a where id > 1
update #m set line_nbr = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetWordNum(data, 1, char(253)), stt_rec = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetWordNum(data, 2, char(253))
if '&ddTable;' in ('42', '83', '26') update #m set ddyn = 'd&ddTable;$000000' else begin set @q = 'update #m set ddyn = ''d&ddTable;$'' + convert(char(6), ngay_ct, 112) from #m a join c&ddTable;$000000 b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec' exec (@q) end
set @q ='' select @q = @q + '; update a set so_ct0 = b.so_ct0, ngay_ct0 = b.ngay_ct0 from #m a join ' + replace(ddyn, 'd', 'm') + ' b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec' from #m where ddyn <> '' group by ddyn exec sp_executesql @q
select top 0 stt_rec, stt_rec0, line_nbr, ma_td1, ma_hd, ma_sp, ma_vv into #d from d&ddTable;$000000 b right join (select null as v) x on 1 = 0 set @q = '' select @q = @q + 'insert into #d select stt_rec, stt_rec0, line_nbr, ma_td1, ma_hd, ma_sp, ma_vv from ' + ddyn + ' a where exists(select * from #m where stt_rec = a.stt_rec) and line_nbr = 1;' from #m where ddyn <> '' group by ddyn exec (@q)
;with hoa_don as ( select distinct stt_rec, ngay_ct0, so_ct0 from ctgt30 a where exists (select 1 from #m x where a.stt_rec = x.stt_rec) ), ds_hoa_don as( SELECT a.stt_rec, max(ngay_ct0) ngay_ct0, STUFF(( SELECT ', ' + RTRIM(so_ct0) FROM hoa_don b WHERE stt_rec = a.stt_rec ORDER BY ngay_ct0, so_ct0 FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)'), 1, 2, '') AS so_ct0 FROM hoa_don a GROUP BY a.stt_rec ) update a set so_ct0 = b.so_ct0, ngay_ct0 = b.ngay_ct0 from #m a join ds_hoa_don b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
update #m set d_ma_td1 = b.ma_td1, d_ma_hd = b.ma_hd, d_ma_sp = b.ma_sp, d_ma_vv = b.ma_vv from #m a join #d b on a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
select '' as array$, rtrim(a.d_ma_td1), rtrim(a.d_ma_hd), rtrim(d_ma_sp), rtrim(d_ma_vv), rtrim(so_ct0), ngay_ct0 from #m a order by line_nbr return
